THEATRE AND FILM — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: THEATRE AND FILM
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Acting: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Acting.
   B. Practise Acting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Acting.
   D. Damage equipment used for Acting.

2. Best practice when working on Theatre and Community: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Theatre and Community.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Theatre and Community.
   C. Damage equipment used for Theatre and Community.
   D. Practise Theatre and Community with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

   B. The speed of the music

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Theatre Adjudication and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Theatre and Community and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Traditional Kenyan Theatre and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Play Writing 1.3 Poetry Writing 2.0 Production 2.1Acting 2.2Theatre Directing 2. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

5. D — Red, blue, and yellow

6. A — Practise Poetry writing – Spoken word with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. B — Practise Theatre Adjudication with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. C — Practise Play Writing with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. C — Practise Acting 2.2Theatre Directing 2.3 Theatre Design 3.0 Theatre, Film and Society 3.1 with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Theatre Adjudication; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)

16. (4 marks)
